skill_name: Write a synopsis of the given text.
workflow: Shrek is an animated movie about an ogre from a swamp who goes on a dangerous quest to reclaim his land and freedom after it is conquered by the sinister Lord Farquad. He is joined in this quest by a donkey, a dragon, and a foolish knight, and has to battle lords and witches. Along the way, he discovers something far more important than his freedom - true friendship and love. The movie is full of comedy, adventure and a satisfying transformation that reunites him with his beloved swamp.
